overviewHtml:
7 Night 6 Days Tour in Nepal shows you the main Tourist attractions of Nepal, during this tour you will visit Kathmandu, Pokhara, and Lumbini Tours. These three cities are the main attractions of this tour. Also, we offer Day Hike in Nepal

These cities have historical values and importance for the tourist with natural beauty, religions, culture, People lifestyle, and ancient traditions. This tour offers you a magnificent Mountain View sunrise and outdoor activities for tourists.

This 7-night6-day tour Package includes English speaking experience tour guide. Responsible and experienced driver. We will provide you with three-star categories of hotels in Kathmandu, Pokhara, and Lumbini. The Hotel provides you delicious and hygienic breakfast with fantastic hospitality and a warm welcome.

In Kathmandu, you will visit incent and heritage sites, like a Swayambhunath, Buddhist stupa (Bouddhanatah), Hindu Temple (Pashupatinath), and Patan Durbar Squire. You will see the different types of architecture, religions, and local cultures in Nepali people's lifestyle.

Pokhara is the best destination for the tourist from where starts a major trekking destination of Annapurna Regions. You can see magnificent Mountain Views with stunning sunrise views. Pokhara is decorated by mountains and lakes where you can feel the Sangrila Himalaya of Nepal.

During your stay in Pokhara, you can do many types of outdoor activities like Paragliding, Bungee Jumping, Jeep flyer, Mountain biking, Boating, and sightseeing around there.

Drive to Lumbini from Pokhara, it takes five hours by private car. Lumbini is the historical city where Buddha was born. Our tour guide will help you to explore around there, and he will explain to you the birthplace of Lord Buddha's history.

When you enter into Lumbini automatically purify your soul by Lord Buddha. Visit the monastery and look around their local villages. Most of the Buddhist religious people and non-Buddhist people visit and pray here because of Buddha Bachan like everybody.

Highlights:

  • Kathmandu Valley sightseeing
  • Visit the world heritage sites
  • Experience the ancient traditions and culture Of Nepal
  • Explore the famous tourist city of Pokhara.
  • Sarangkot is the famous mountain viewpoint of Pokhara
  • Magnificent Annapurna Himalaya Range and Sunrise from Sarankot
  • Mt. Fishtail (6993m), Mt Annapurna (8,091m) Dhaulagiri (8167m
  • Visit World Peace Pagoda, International Mountain Museum
  • Fewa Lake boating, David Falls, Gupteswar Mahadev Cave
  • Visit the Lord Buddha's birthplace
  • Amazing drive on the mountain and a mountain flight from Lumbini to Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu International Airport 1345m.
itinerary.description: Welcome to Nepal and Tribhuwan International Airport in Kathmandu. You will receive by Nepal Unique Treks team who will help you with the transfer to the hotel in Thamel by private car. After Checking the Hotel, take a rest or stroll around Thamel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Sightseeing with private tour Guide. 1345m
itinerary.description: Early in the morning breakfast in the Hotel. Meet with a tour guide and start your Kathmandu Valley sightseeing. Explore tourist cities and heritage sites. The guide will show you continuously Swayambhunath, Bouddhanath Stupa, and Pashupatinath (Hindu Temple). We will provide a private tourist vehicle with a professional driver and English-speaking tour guide for the tour. In the early afternoon return to the hotel and relax. In the evening Nepal Unique Treks Team leader will invite you to join us for a welcome dinner in Thamel, and a briefing about the Nepal Holiday.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Pokhara by car 210 km, 7/8 hrs. 810 m
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we will drive towards the Pokhara from Kathmandu. It takes about 7 to 8 hours by private car and 1 more hour by tourist bus. The driver will take you to the Pokhara through the Prithibi Highway and the white water rafting river which is popularly known Trisuli River. During the road drive, we will be enjoying the beautiful side view of the natural beauties of the local villages.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Valley Sightseeing 810m, 6 Hrs
itinerary.description: Pokhara is one of the best tourist destinations and the most fascinating and beautiful places in Nepal. It is the main point to start trekking for the Annapurna Regions of Nepal. Also, Pokhara is the best place for land tours and sightseeing, where we can see a marvelous view of mountains, Sunrise, Sunset, Cultural museum, and Touristic outdoor activities. Today you will visit a major part of attraction of all in Pokhara. Like International Mountain Museum, World Peace Stupa, David Waterfalls, Gupteswari Mahadev Cave, Tibetan Refugee Camp, Mattepani Monastery, and Fewa Lake Bindabasini Temple. After the all-day visit in Pokhara back to the hotel and take a rest. In the evening you are free to explore Lakeside and enjoy your dinner.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Lumbini by Car
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, 4:30 am your tour guide will take you to the Sarangkot Viewpoint by private tourist car to see the magnificent view of the Annapurna Himalaya range with stunning sunrise view. From the Sarangkot viewpoint, we can see 15 more snow peaks in the mountains with beautiful lakeside and Pokhara Valley. Around 30 m, enjoy Glories Mountain View and drive back to Pokhara Hotel. Pack your bag pack and have breakfast at Pokhara Hotel. Then we will drive to the Lumbini. It takes 5/6 hrs.’ slowly by private car. We will have lunch on the way to arrive in Lumbini. In the early afternoon, we will arrive at the Hotel. You will enjoy walking around the Buddha Maya Garden and praying. Tonight you will have a delicious dinner in the Hotel and sleep overnight.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Lumbini Buddha Birthplace, fly to Kathmandu at evening
itinerary.description: We will have breakfast in the Hotel. Then, your tour guide will bring you to explore Sidartha Gouttam Buddha Born Place and many more Buddhist religious Monasteries. Also, we can visit the important Buddhist archeological sites of the Lumbini where we can enjoy the great view of the sacred birthplace of Lord Buddha. Also, visit the museum and other several things related to Lord Buddha and his ancient history. After lunch in the Hotel drive to Bhairahawa Airport to fly to Kathmandu. Finally, Last night enjoy in Nepal. Our team leaders will invite you to take farewell dinners in Nepali Cultural Restaurant. You are free to enjoy if you like Kathmandu nightlife for drinks or shopping. You are safe to walk around your shelf.

itinerary.title: Departure to International Airport 1345m. 30m
itinerary.description: Nepal Unique Treks staff will transfer you to the airport. Three hours before then your flight schedule. You will be entry inside the airport to go won word your destination and our guide will return to Thamel.
